The series features the voices of Brenda Song, Justin Felbinger, Bill Farmer, Amanda Leighton, Anna Akana, Troy Baker, Haley Tju, and Keith David. The series follows Anne Boonchuy (Song), a young girl who finds herself trapped in a world of anthropomorphic amphibian creatures. Amphibia premiered on June 17, 2019, running for three seasons until concluding on May 14, 2022. The series has received positive reviews, with praise for its characters, animation, voice acting, humor, and emotional weight. The series additionally won an award for Best Character Design at the 2021 Annie Awards.
